description: Turn leftover cooked lentils into patties, a tomato skillet, soup, or a grain bowl with this practical four-route dinner guide.
h1: What to Make With Leftover Lentils: A 4-Route Dinner Decision Guide
intro: A container of cooked lentils can become dinner much faster than it can become a plan. Start by choosing the kind of meal you want tonight: something crisp, something saucy, something brothy, or a bowl that needs very little cooking.
This guide assumes the lentils are already cooked and ready to use in a meal. For any ingredients you are unsure about, use your own judgment and follow the package guidance.

sections.heading: Quick answer: choose your dinner shape

headers: If dinner needs to feel like…
rows: egg, breadcrumbs, onion, herbs, yogurt or a sauce
canned tomatoes, pasta, rice, greens, cheese
stock, onion, carrots, canned tomatoes, small pasta
rice, couscous, roasted vegetables, lemon, feta, tahini

paragraphs_after: Pick one route, then use the branches for what is already nearby in your fridge or cupboard.

sections.heading: Route 1: Turn them into crisp lentil patties
paragraphs: Choose this route when you have a few bits and pieces to bind the lentils together and want dinner with a little crunch.

sections.heading: Basic patty mix
paragraphs: Mash about half the lentils with a fork, leaving the rest whole for texture. Stir in one binding ingredient and one flavour ingredient:
Shape into small patties and cook in a lightly oiled pan until each side is browned and firm enough to lift easily.
list: **Binding:** an egg, breadcrumbs, cooked rice, mashed potato, or oats
**Flavour:** chopped onion, garlic, grated carrot, herbs, curry powder, cumin, or a spoonful of pesto

sections.heading: Make it a meal
paragraphs: **If you also have leftover mashed potatoes:** use them as the binder, then compare the result with the crisp routes in [[https://delixioapp.com/guides/what-to-make-with-leftover-mashed-potatoes-a-4-route-dinner-decision-tree/|this leftover mashed-potato decision tree]].
list: Put the patties in a wrap with salad leaves and a yogurt or tahini sauce.
Serve them with roasted vegetables and a simple dressing.
Add a fried egg and toast for a low-effort dinner plate.

sections.heading: Route 2: Make a quick lentil tomato skillet
paragraphs: Choose this when you want something saucy that can meet pasta, rice, toast, or a baked potato.
steps: Soften onion, garlic, or any vegetables that need using in a pan.
Add a spoonful of tomato paste, canned tomatoes, passata, or even a jarred sauce.
Fold in the lentils with a splash of water or stock until everything is warm and spoonable.
Finish with something bright or creamy: herbs, lemon, grated cheese, yogurt, or a drizzle of olive oil.

sections.heading: Easy variations
paragraphs: A nearly empty tube of tomato paste can still be useful here; if that is the missing piece, see [[https://delixioapp.com/guides/what-can-i-use-instead-of-tomato-paste-a-pantry-substitution-guide-for-weeknight/|what to use instead of tomato paste]].
list: **With pasta:** toss the sauce with short pasta and add spinach or peas at the end.
**With rice:** spoon it over rice and top with a fried egg or crumbled feta.
**With bread:** make it thicker, pile it onto toast, and add cheese if you have it.
**With roasted vegetables:** use the skillet as the saucy part of the plate.

sections.heading: Route 3: Build a fast lentil soup from small amounts
paragraphs: Choose this route when your fridge has a few vegetables that would work better together than separately.
Start with onion, carrot, celery, leek, peppers, or a handful of greens. Cook them briefly, then add lentils, stock or water, and one flavour direction:
A handful of lentils gives the soup body. Blend a small portion only if you want a thicker bowl; keep the rest whole for texture.
list: **Tomato and herbs:** canned tomatoes, oregano, basil, and small pasta or beans
**Lemony and green:** lemon, spinach, peas, dill, parsley, or yogurt at the table
**Warm and spiced:** cumin, smoked paprika, curry powder, or harissa, plus a spoonful of yogurt

sections.heading: Best for: the vegetable drawer dinner
paragraphs: This route works especially well after you have used the same vegetables in another meal. If your leftovers are roasted rather than raw, use the texture-first choices in [[https://delixioapp.com/guides/what-to-do-with-leftover-roasted-vegetables-a-texture-first-dinner-decision-tree/|this guide to leftover roasted vegetables]].

sections.heading: Route 4: Make a lentil bowl with a warm base
paragraphs: Choose this when you have cooked rice, couscous, quinoa, potatoes, or a grain packet, and want dinner assembled rather than cooked from scratch.
steps: **Warm base:** rice, couscous, potatoes, or grains
**Lentils:** warmed with olive oil, spices, or a splash of dressing
**Vegetable:** roasted vegetables, chopped cucumber, greens, tomatoes, or any cooked vegetables you have
**Creamy or sharp finish:** feta, yogurt, tahini, pesto, lemon, pickles, or toasted seeds

sections.heading: Three flavour directions

rows: Lentils + couscous + greens + lemony tahini dressing
Lentils + rice + tomatoes + a spoonful of pesto
Lentils + roasted vegetables + yogurt + cumin or smoked paprika

paragraphs_after: Half a jar of tahini is useful far beyond dressing; [[https://delixioapp.com/guides/how-to-use-half-a-jar-of-tahini-6-dinner-and-snack-routes/|these tahini dinner routes]] can help you use the rest in a different meal.

sections.heading: A tiny decision tree for the container in your fridge
list: **You have lentils plus an egg or a starchy leftover:** make patties.
**You have lentils plus tomatoes or a jarred sauce:** make the skillet.
**You have lentils plus several small vegetables:** make soup.
**You have lentils plus a cooked grain or potato:** build a bowl.
**You have lentils plus almost nothing else:** warm them with olive oil and spices, put them on toast, and add whatever fresh or creamy topping you can find.

sections.heading: Common mistakes that make leftover lentils feel repetitive
list: **Using the same seasoning every time.** Change the flavour direction before you change the whole meal: tomato-herb, lemony, smoky, or warmly spiced all send lentils somewhere different.
**Adding them too early to a crisp recipe.** Mash only part of the lentils and keep some whole for better texture.
**Treating a small amount as too little.** A modest portion can still anchor a bowl, stretch a sauce, or give soup more substance.
**Making a second full batch when a route would do.** Pick the dinner shape first, then add only the ingredients that support it.

sections.heading: Make the next lentil dinner easier
paragraphs: The useful part of a leftover is rarely the exact amount. It is the head start it gives you: protein and texture are already handled, so the rest of dinner can be built around the ingredients close by.

If you have more than lentils in the kitchen, add what you have to Delixio and get meal ideas based on your actual ingredients. You can save the ones you like and keep the missing items together for the next grocery trip.
